recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast cinematic photograph of a football player in full white uniform sitting on a locker room floor, surrounded by excessive piles of cash, sports gear, and illicit-looking packages, creating a narrative of corruption or sudden wealth within a gritty athletic setting.
coreVisualRelationships: The player as the central vertical axis against the horizontal grid of lockers.
The stark white of the uniform against the muddy brown of the lockers.
The chaotic piles of money in the foreground framing the subject's feet.
coreInvariants: Brown metal lockers with horizontal vents
A white helmet with black star decals

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, seated figure occupying the middle third of the frame, slightly below eye level.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The football player's white uniform acts as a bright focal point against the dark background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the player's face/hands, moves down the white uniform to the money-covered floor, then outward to the bags and lockers.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with objects to emphasize excess.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Brown (lockers and floor) providing a warm, gritty base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright White (uniform, helmet, cleats) for high-key separation.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Green and Gold (money and flowers) adding small pops of saturated color.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the subject and background; desaturated environment with localized saturation in props.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold sans-serif for utility and branding.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, authoritative look of standard advisory labels.
Provides a similar industrial, no-nonsense feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide shot of a football player in a white uniform sitting on a locker room floor. The floor is covered in stacks of money and sports bags. The background consists of brown metal lockers. Lighting is dramatic and cinematic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a small rectangular warning label in the bottom right corner with bold, condensed black sans-serif text on a white background, surrounded by a black border.

verificationChecks: Is the money clearly visible on the floor?
Is the uniform bright white against a dark locker background?

adjustableVariables: Amount of money on the floor
Presence of secondary props like flowers or bags
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the player
Any specific team logos on the helmet
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic money texture and stacking.
Ensure the white uniform doesn't blow out highlights too much.
Verify the locker room looks aged and used.
Confirm the text label is strictly in the corner.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in high-contrast uniform + Gritty industrial background + Foreground clutter of wealth/contraband + Cinematic studio lighting = Urban Narrative Aesthetic.
